messages:
maria: UmbraTech follow-up from presales call. They want an out-of-the-box compat shim for RivalAPI v1 so they don't have to touch their client. Key asks: streaming termination exact bytes, function call JSON shape, and behavior when model returns no tokens (they expect explicit null). Also they want a price estimate for ~500k tok/mo and a 99th percentile latency SLO. Can eng/SEC comment?
sam-sales: customer is risk-averse on infra changes. Prefer hosted POC. Willing to sign 3-month contract if we do cost share on engineering work.
kevin: Technical feasibility: yes. We'll implement a per-tenant middleware that rewrites responses to match RivalAPI wire format. Corner cases: RivalAPI uses `null` for empty completions; our models sometimes emit empty string. Adapter must convert empty-string->null and ensure function-calling objects include `arguments` as stringified JSON (they expect that). That transformation is straightforward but we must include test vectors.
sophia: Streaming: RivalAPI sends SSE with `data: {"delta":"..."}\n\n` and terminates with `data: [DONE]\n\n` (two newlines). We'll match exact byte sequence including newline style. Also they stream control frames occasionally; we'll drop our internal `meta` frames in compat mode. Ops impact: slight CPU re-encode and a small change to egress accounting.
kevin: Rate-limits: RivalAPI returns 429 with `Retry-After` in seconds. We should mirror that header. Our token-bucket will continue to operate; adapter returns 429 responses from upstream unchanged so client sees same behavior. Add regression to ensure header preserved.
alex-security: Compliance checklist from their security: 1) Data residency: must keep logs in us-west for POC; 2) KMS: BYOK required? 3) Audit logs: need export of request traces for a two-week window.
sophia: Answers: (1) POC tenant can be pinned to us-west, logs retention policy set to 14d; (2) BYOK for POC is heavy, but we can do a temporary customer-managed key in our KMS integration for the shim container—need security approval; (3) we can provide audit export in CSV with masked PII. I'll draft the control matrix and checklist.
maria: Pricing ask: UmbraTech asked for 50% off hosted rate for 3 months or a small dedicated pool with 3mo commit. What do we recommend?
kevin: Suggested offer: hosted + 30% POC discount plus $X of eng credits for shim work. Dedicated short-term commit increases ops burden; only offer if they need strict SLOs. For a guaranteed 99p latency SLO, propose a reserved micro-pool (2 gpus) as a paid add-on.
sam-sales: I'll push for 40% and attach conditional clause: discount contingent on feedback and short case study.
deploy-bot: env created: p-umbra-002 (us-west) — http://console.redwood/p/p-umbra-002 — note: compat_mode=rivalapi_v1 enabled as feature flag.
kevin: Action items: 1) I'll build shim prototype that: a) converts empty->null, b) stringifies function-call arguments to match RivalAPI, c) strips internal meta frames and enforces `data: [DONE]\n\n` termination. Target: Tue EOD. 2) Add CI test harness that replays RivalAPI captured SSE (we'll store samples under ci/compat/umbra).
sophia: Security action: list of required approvals for BYOK and KMS variation; I'll produce the POC control doc and redact examples.
maria: Ops: Provide a one-page runbook for the demo (Wed 10am PT) covering: how to toggle compat_mode, how to collect traces, and how to disable persistence if customer requests. Sam will negotiate commercial terms; I'll draft a short term-sheet after perf results.
kevin: Quick replay example for tests:
```bash
# capture sample from RivalAPI
curl -N "https://api.rival.example/v1/stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer RIVAL_TOKEN" -o rival.sse
# replay through our shim to validate client behavior
curl -N "https://p-umbra-002.internal/compat/stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST" --data-binary @rival.sse | sed -n '$p' # check final frame
```
kevin: I'll also run sample prompts to detect detokenization differences (apostrophes vs escaped unicode). If outputs differ in meaning we may need a post-process detokenizer shim.
sam-sales: noted. I'll align contract ask with 40% discount + short case study.
maria: Great. Keep updates in this thread.
